items.afrikaansBefore: 1. Span net oor klein persele graan.
items.afrikaansAfter: 1. Span 'n net oor klein persele graan.
items.problem: Without an article, "net" reads first as the adverb "only" ("Only stretch over small plots of grain"), so a farmer may not see that the step means covering the grain with netting against quelea.
